query: Hey, I was at this little local coffee shop near my hotel this morning and they had the best honey lavender latte I’ve ever tasted, I even asked the barista for their recipe to try making it at home when I get back. Also, I stopped by a street market on the way back and picked up this really cute hand-painted phone case, the design is all local flower motifs, it fits my phone perfectly. Oh, and I was thinking of going to a hiking trail nearby tomorrow, I’m trying to figure out if I need to rent a pair of walking shoes since the ones I brought are kind of worn out. Anyway, I’m currently abroad right now and I have roaming turned off, but my MMS messages won’t send at all, I think there’s something wrong with my APN MMS settings, can you help me figure out what’s going on with that?
